name: handoff-node-sibling-does-not-implement-withdraw-404
description: R30 / AE16 -- THE ASYMMETRY, RECORDED. The sibling Node coordinator does not implement POST /handoff/withdraw and answers 404 with the shared error envelope. The bearer is the harness's VALID one: Node rejects auth before routing, so a bad bearer would answer 401 and say nothing about which routes exist. The day Node grows the route this row goes red. It must RUN, not skip: test_handoff_corpus.py fails rather than xfails when the plugin dist cannot be resolved.
